caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object placed centrally on a plain light beige background. The object resembles a pair of ornate scissors or snuffers, made of brownish metal with a speckled texture. It has two finger rings, one larger and one smaller, attached to a flat body that narrows and expands in elegantly curved, decorative patterns on both ends. Near the joint, there is a raised dome-like feature, and an elongated, truncated, box-like structure extends parallel to one of the handles. Both ends of the object have intricate, looped designs, and the overall shape is symmetrical with an emphasis on flowing lines and curves. There is a small, neat handwritten signature or note in the lower right portion of the image, beneath the object. The composition is minimalistic, with the object isolated against the unadorned background.
title: Wrought Iron Bit
